All related originals were actually viewed earlier by this same reviewer in this run and are explicitly reused below. No mechanical pass substitutes for viewing. REMOTE_QUIET_NATIVE was observed; no program/tests/build/probe/automatic verification/SSH/hash/copy/crop/image processing occurred.
capture_diagnostic_context: The manifest reports incomplete capture-suite execution and mechanical_success=false. Only present assigned frames are assessed; their per-case results do not imply successful full-suite or business verification.
